summary:
Implementation plan to address all 7 user issues:
1. MultiBackupModal responsive mobile layout overhaul (compact padding, sticky actions, scroll-safe pills).
2. Attendance printing & PDF formatting upgrade (full register with Worker Name, Date, Status, 12h Duty Hours, Wages & Advances).
3. Main Menu Language option addition (top quick bar pills + Settings & Support item with Languages icon).
4. Header Download/Backup icon color alignment with dynamic theme tokens.
5. Attendance View Details bug fix (date normalization and missing View Details action button on attendance cards).
6. Header translated text overlap fix (flex containment, single-line text-ellipsis truncation).
7. Full linting, syntax, and build verification.
